# Scaling Available Frequencies (S5E8845)

See https://www.kernel.org/doc/Documentation/power/pm_qos_interface.txt

> Alternatively the user mode program could write a hex
> string for the value using 10 char long format e.g. "0x12345678".

## CPU Little Cluster (CPU0-3)

               0x12345678

    2050000 -> 0x001f47d0
    1920000 -> 0x001d4c00
    1824000 -> 0x001bd500
    1728000 -> 0x001a5e00
    1632000 -> 0x0018e700
    1536000 -> 0x00177000
    1440000 -> 0x0015f900
    1344000 -> 0x00148200
    1248000 -> 0x00130b00
    1152000 -> 0x00119400
    1056000 -> 0x00101d00
     960000 -> 0x000ea600
     864000 -> 0x000d2f00
     768000 -> 0x000bb800
     672000 -> 0x000a4100
     533000 -> 0x00082208
